message.content:
A medium‑sized tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 calories**.  
The calorie count can vary slightly depending on size and variety:

| Size (approx. weight) | Calories |
|-----------------------|----------|
| Small (≈90 g)         | 15–18    |
| Medium (≈123 g)       | 22       |
| Large (≈182 g)        | 33–35    |

So if you’re eating a typical medium tomato, you’re looking at about 20–25 calories.
